_doc: Needle spec for diag-eval-v3. The QUERY is always the QUESTION (never the needle text) -> guards query<->document leakage (design 2.4/6.1). 'ground_truth.value' is a VERBATIM substring that MUST exist in exactly one ingested narrative unit; pre-flight resolves it to a parent_unit_id (design C4/OQ#2). 'answerable:false' questions are calibration negatives for the inject silence-gate (design M4/5.2): pre-flight asserts NO unit substring-matches them.
